criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 27 November 2027 (12 months after the 27 November 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 27 November 2028 (24 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 27 November 2029 (36 months after Closing).

Identifies that the MAC carve-outs (general economic, industry-wide and pandemic changes) contain no 'disproportionate effect' exception, so the Buyer bears those risks even where the Company is disproportionately affected, and recommends adding one.

Identifies the conflict between the 30-day claim notice period in SPA Section 9.7 and the 60-day period in Escrow Clause 5.2, and recommends the Buyer works to the shorter 30-day period or aligns the documents.

Identifies that the board approval was given at a meeting with only 2 directors present when Article 11 requires a quorum of three, so the approval may be invalid, and recommends a fresh or ratifying resolution.
Explains how 'material adverse effect' could be read narrowly or broadly and what each reading means for the Buyer's walk-away right.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (12 months) and as a date (27 November 2027), with days remaining from 31 August 2026 (453 days).
Shows proposed drafting changes as before/after (current wording vs proposed wording) with a one-line rationale.
